titolo: Zelensky Sank a Russian Warship in Libya. Now Moscow Vows Revenge
angolo: A Russian warship sunk 2,400 km from the front: what Zelensky confirmed, who condemned it, and what Moscow and Italy say comes next
descrizione: Zelensky Sank a Russian Warship in Libya. Now Moscow Vows Revenge. Ukraine says seven naval drones sank the Russian corvette Merkury in Benghazi, Libya. Zelensky confirmed it on Monday, Libya's governments condemned it, Italy warned of spillover, and the Kremlin promised painful consequences. Here is what is confirmed, what is only claimed, and what could come next.

scene.testo: Sunday, before dawn. A Russian warship is blown apart in a Libyan port.
Ukraine says it sent seven naval drones across the water. None carried a crew.
Today, Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine did this.
The target was the corvette Merkury, which Zelensky called one of Russia's newest ships.
Satellite images show it mostly underwater, having capsized.
Now Moscow warns of painful consequences.
Why did Ukraine take its war to Libya, and what does Russia do next?
Stay with me. In a moment, the distance that makes this strike unusual.
First, the man who announced it.
Volodymyr Zelensky is the president of Ukraine.
Since 2022, Ukraine has repeatedly used naval drones against Russian warships in the Black Sea.
In 2024, Ukraine claimed it sank the corvette Ivanovets with sea drones.
But Benghazi is another scale. One analysis puts it more than 2,400 kilometers from the Ukrainian front.
The raid followed an attack last week on the Kerch Bridge.
And a day earlier, a Russian-owned cargo ship was struck by drones in the Baltic Sea.
Finland's military said Ukraine likely carried that one out.
Why was a Russian warship in Libya at all? That's next.
Eastern Libya is controlled by military commander Khalifa Haftar.
His Libyan National Army maintains ties with Russia.
Eastern authorities said the Merkury had docked to refuel and take on supplies.
That, they said, was under a cooperation agreement with Russia.
The Institute for the Study of War says the corvette had stopped at the port for several days while escorting Russian cargo ships.
Ukraine's security service said the Merkury had guarded the cargo ship Angara.
It says Angara is sanctioned and carried Russian military equipment.
Those are Kyiv's claims. Russia has not confirmed the loss.
Next: how seven drones got that close, according to Ukraine.
Ukraine's security service says the drones launched from a mothership.
Zelensky says all seven were made in Ukraine.
They struck in the early hours of Sunday morning.
A British maritime firm, Ambrey, said some of the explosions were likely caused by ammunition aboard detonating.
Eastern Libyan authorities described a brief fire.
A Ka-27 helicopter was aboard. Zelensky and Ukraine's security service say it was destroyed too.
Hours later, according to local media reports picked up by AP, a Maltese-flagged commercial ship was also hit off Benghazi.
The Libyan coast guard reported that hit. Who owns that ship is not established here.
At first, nobody claimed it. Libya's east called it a suspected drone attack.
Then came Monday, and Zelensky's own words.
He posted video of a massive explosion on the Russian ship.
He wrote that despite the enemy's efforts, the corvette was sunk.

visivo.testo: The Russian corvette Merkury was sunk.

citazione.testo: Despite all the enemy's efforts to counter the attack, the Russian corvette Merkury was sunk.

scene.testo: He called it an exemplary operation, and said the ship was commissioned in 2023.
And he added a line that matters for what comes next.
We continue our operations in designated waters.

visivo.testo: We continue our operations in designated waters.

citazione.testo: We continue our operations in designated waters.

scene.testo: Libya's governments were not pleased. Both condemned it.
The UN-recognized government in Tripoli condemned the attacks.
It said Libya would not be drawn into the war.
The eastern administration called it a violation of Libya's sovereignty.
It launched an investigation with Russia into who was behind it.
Its prime minister asked the UN to look into suspicions.
That the boats had been launched from western Libya.
He also asked it to check the presence of Ukrainian military experts there.
That is an allegation by eastern Libyan officials. Ukraine has not confirmed it.
The UN mission in Libya voiced serious concern.
It said Libya must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts.

visivo.testo: Libya must not become a battleground.

scene.testo: Across the sea, one capital was listening closely. Rome.
Italy's foreign minister, Antonio Tajani, spoke from Baku.
He said that if this is a continuation of the Russia-Ukraine war a few hundred kilometers from Italy, it is worrying.
He said war in the Mediterranean must be avoided.

visivo.testo: He said war in the Mediterranean must be avoided.

scene.testo: He added that Rome wants a stable Libya, and Russian presence needs close watching.
He also offered a view on the timing.
When peace dialogue begins, he said, military activity always increases.
Fox News reported that peace talks resumed this month after a nine-month pause.
So what does Moscow say? The answer came Monday.
Then spokesman Dmitry Peskov said the Defense Ministry was handling the matter.
He said it would share details if it deemed that appropriate.
Russia's Defense Ministry had not commented on the incident, according to the Epoch Times.
Peskov called it a very dangerous trend.
Daily Russian strikes on Ukraine, he said, 'have very painful consequences for the Kyiv regime.'
Asked about a response, Peskov said Russian forces carry out large-scale strikes on Ukraine daily.
Russia's ambassador to Libya, Aydar Aganin, spoke to RT.
He said the attack will not go unanswered and Moscow is considering its response options.
He also claimed Kyiv's Western backers provided logistical and intelligence support.
Peskov also hoped Baltic states would press Kyiv to stop what he called terrorist practices.
Kyiv's position is different. Zelensky says Ukraine is responding to Russia's aggression.
Al Jazeera says the attacks come amid a Ukrainian campaign targeting Russian naval assets, energy infrastructure and vessels linked to Moscow's so-called shadow fleet.
That fleet helps Russia evade Western sanctions, according to Al Jazeera.
What is claimed: Zelensky says seven drones sank the Merkury.
Satellite imagery shows the ship capsized. Libya's governments condemned it.
